entity.title: Modules
entity.description: Structure and contracts of the engine packages under src/.

rules.body: MUST report findings as result.Diagnostic values in a result.Result and MUST NOT log, print or exit from inside a module.
MUST emit diagnostic codes only from the prefix the module owns (RL rulelint, RD rulediff, RM realmlint, RR realmresolve, RSV ruleresolve, RE ruleeval).
MUST NOT reuse or renumber a diagnostic code once it has shipped in a release; a retired check keeps its code reserved.
MUST fetch JSON schemas from steerspec.dev through the schema package and MUST NOT embed schema copies in the binary.
MUST NOT import packages from strspc-CLI or strspc-cloud; dependencies point from consumers to the manager only.
MUST describe every diagnostic code a module emits in docs/SPEC.md.
MUST emit diagnostic codes only from the prefix the module owns (RL rulelint, RD rulediff, RM realmlint, RR realmresolve, RSV ruleresolve, RE ruleeval, EC evalcache).
MUST emit diagnostic codes only from the prefix the module owns (RL rulelint, RD rulediff, RM realmlint, RR realmresolve, RSV ruleresolve, RE ruleeval, EC evalcache, RF rulerefs).
MUST register every diagnostic code a module emits in result.Codes() with a non-empty Title and Fix.
MUST prove every diagnostic code fires through a public API, with a scenario or case in src/qa.
